findings.location: Decision 3, “Free a literal call of another module command”
findings.problem: The proposed exemption applies to every current and future module command, but its safety depends on each helper dispatching only an exact first argument. Per-helper tests at implementation time do not preserve that condition when a module is added or its helper changes; a later helper that accepts prefixes, aliases, or re-dispatches another argument would silently receive the exemption.
findings.suggestion: Make the exemption an explicit reviewed allowlist, or establish and enforce a module-declaration/verification invariant that every eligible helper uses an exact first-argument dispatch. Require revalidation before a new or changed helper can receive the exemption.

summary: The proposed universal exemption lacks an enforceable safety boundary for future module helpers.
